result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom nav all render consistently. Excluding the expected carousel edge-clipping and bottom viewport cutoff, only minor visual inconsistencies remain: the promo banner's decorative circles are clipped flat at the banner's right/bottom edge, the partially visible category chip at the right edge shows as an empty sliver with no label, and the bottom navigation lacks a clear active-state indicator distinguishing the current tab beyond color (Profile is green while Home appears default gray despite the feed being a home feed).

issues.description: The decorative translucent circles on the green promo banner are cut off abruptly at the banner's right and bottom edges, producing hard flat edges instead of soft circular shapes.
issues.suggestion: Clip the decorative circles within the banner bounds using overflow hidden with intentional positioning, or adjust their size/placement so the cropping looks deliberate rather than accidental.

issues.description: A sixth category chip is barely visible at the right edge as a thin empty sliver with no visible label, which reads as a rendering artifact rather than a scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the peeking chip shows at least part of its label (e.g., add right padding to the row or reduce chip spacing) so users recognize it as a scrollable item.

issues.description: Bottom navigation active state is ambiguous: 'Profile' is highlighted green while the visible content is the home feed, and 'Home' appears unselected, suggesting a mismatch between the selected tab and displayed screen.
issues.suggestion: Sync the highlighted tab with the currently displayed screen (highlight 'Home' on the feed view) or clarify the navigation state logic.
